articles.summary: AudioCodes announced that its Voca Conversational Interaction Center (Voca CIC), working with Go2Uno, a business communications service provider, and Atento, a top-5 global BPO, successfully delivered a large-scale Voice Agent and Conversational IVR modernization for a major healthcare organization in record time.
articles.title: AudioCodes Announces a Large-Scale Voca CIC Voice Agent Deployment with Atento
